journal_lines: Skeleton archer in the dark. Kept moving.
Rattling thing in the path. Dealt with it.
Three arrows stuck in the dirt. None in me.
Bones and sinew and a bow. Closed the distance.
Three of them in a line. Moved to the flank.
Drew it out of the dark. Better on open ground.
Skeleton with a rusted sword instead. Easier.
The clicking sound first. Then the arrow. Then nothing.
Found it before it could set itself. Over quickly.
Old bones. Hit hard enough times they come apart.
The dark was mine more than its.
Arrows in the dirt, arrows in the trees. None in me.
